remarks: Great opportunity to make this spacious one-bedroom ranch style condominium in the heart of Norwalk your own.  Add your personal design to the modern updates you will enjoy in this home. The dark flooring in the large living room/dining area creates a warm and inviting feel as you enter the home. Sit at the peninsula in the updated Kitchen or at your table in the dining area to enjoy meals. You will be happy with the size of the bedroom which also boasts dark flooring along with a large closet. There is even more storage space in the unit with three additional closets and an on-site storage unit. Easy living with a great location in the complex, just steps to the unit from the secure building entrance and close to the elevator which leads to the lower level laundry room. Heat, Hot Water, cooking gas, two off-street parking spaces in a gated lot and an on-site complex Superintendent are all included in the low common charges. WOW! Everything you need to make this home your own. Great commuter location, Sheffield Ridge Condominiums are conveniently located to the Metro North Train Stations, I-95, The Merritt Parkway, Public Transportation, shopping, restaurants, nightlife, movie theatre, health clubs, parks, Aquarium, Ice skating & more. Minutes to Historic South Norwalk and the SoNo Collection Mall. Short drive to Calf Pasture Beach and Cranbury Park. AGENTS- please see remarks.
